description: Source code for the Gpt (General Purpose Timer) module implementation in an AUTOSAR-based embedded system, specifically for MPC55xx architecture. Contains initialization, deinitialization, timer control, notification, and wakeup functions, along with ISR definitions.

methods.name: Gpt_Init
methods.description: Initializes the GPT module with provided configuration, sets up ISRs for channels, and starts timers.

methods.name: Gpt_DeInit
methods.description: Deinitializes the GPT module, stops all timers, and resets internal state.

methods.name: Gpt_StartTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer on a specified channel with a given period in ticks.

methods.name: Gpt_StopTimer
methods.description: Stops the timer on a specified channel.

methods.name: Gpt_GetTimeRemaining
methods.description: Returns the remaining time in ticks for a running timer channel.

methods.name: Gpt_GetTimeElapsed
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time in ticks since the timer was started.

methods.name: Gpt_EnableNotification
methods.description: Enables interrupt notification for a specified timer channel.

methods.name: Gpt_DisableNotification
methods.description: Disables interrupt notification for a specified timer channel.

methods.name: Gpt_SetMode
methods.description: Sets the timer mode to normal or sleep, enabling or disabling timers accordingly.

methods.name: Gpt_DisableWakeup
methods.description: Disables wakeup capability for a specified channel, only RTI supported.

methods.name: Gpt_EnableWakeup
methods.description: Enables wakeup capability for a specified channel, only RTI supported.

methods.name: Gpt_Cbk_CheckWakeup
methods.description: Callback function to check wakeup sources (empty implementation).
